title: My mall world happened to have a hospital, and it was creepy
content: First of all, surprised I found this sub. My mall world is a freaking labyrinth. Today I’ve discovered a new part of my mall world and it was creepy. So far I know it has: - a mall in the very middle of the structure, with jewelry, glass figurines, trinkets mainly really. It is very rich and a little bit old-school, there’s a fountain structure in the middle and 2 to 4 identical round stairs up. - a level with dining area. It looks a little poor, a little dark, dark wooden tables, more of a cantina vibe and it is always almost deserted. People who dine there are always a little grumpy and it is always hard to find personnel. The personnel wears dark green uniforms. - a level with cocktails area. This zone is very nice, a little posh, with atmospheric lighting and white tall tables. Everyone there looks good, classy. Male personnel is working there. There’s a door to the hang out area where people can sit in bigger groups. It’s more loud. - a level with suits. It looks like a ship slash hotel. Everything is blueish gray there - walls, carpets, ceilings, furniture inside the rooms. A lot of maids walking the corridors. I frequently get lost there, because everything is so similar looking. - a level with hospital. It is greenish with bright annoying lights. It was creepy because it is for people who are dying. I got lost there, found a corridor with a door where old or terminally I’ll people were queuing. They were in the state of being not alive but also not dead. I got scared of the door and went back. Found personnel at the reception and they told me how to get out.
